name: Terminal layouts, Hong Kong search lines, and log-scale charts
body:
## Highlights

- **Terminal panes fit what they show.** `OMON` keeps the puts in view and says how many fields it hid, `ECO` and Help show whole columns, the 5Y chart axis no longer skips a year, and Home, setup and the field picker fit narrow windows. (#2700)
- **Dates and empty values read one way.** Dates are day-first (`18 Sep '25`), clocks name their zone with summer time, a missing value always shows the same mark, and terminal text wraps at spaces instead of inside numbers. (#2699)
- **Search keeps Hong Kong and China lines.** `hsbc` lists HSBC's 0005 in Hong Kong again, `aia` finds 1299 and `ccb` finds 0939, and a slow first search no longer reads "No matches". (#2719)
- **Log scale on the Overview chart.** A wide-ranging history such as NVDA's draws on a log axis by itself, and the pane menu has a switch that is remembered. (#2713)

## Also in this release

- Growth off a negative base and margins over negative revenue read N/M, and an insurer's EV reads N/M. (#2696)
- German names: a bare ticker opens its home listing, European index moves are dated, and Xetra earnings fill in. (#2705, #2711)
- Panes report a failed load instead of waiting silently, and a failed quote batch no longer retries in a loop. (#2708, #2709, #2710)

[Full diff](https://github.com/gloom-sh/gloomberb/compare/v0.20.12...v0.20.13)
